.²1 An exception, a prohibitive rule or precept; {#prADAnyaM hi viDeryatra#}
 {#pratizeDe'praDAnatA . paryudAsaH sa vijYeyo yatrottarapadena naY ..#}

.²2 A negation purporting to state some matter of the exclusion of something
 that is actually mentioned. Technically {#naY#} (the negative particle)
 has the sense of {#paryudAsa#} when it is connected with any word that
 is not a verb. But it conveys {#pratizeDa#} when it is connected with
 a verb. Thus {#abrAhmaRam Anaya#} means {#brAhmaRaM varjayitvA yaM kamapi#}
 {#Anaya#}; while {#kalaYjaM na Bakzayet#} conveys prohibition of {#kalaYjaBakzaRa#}.
 For a discussion on {#paryudAsa#} read <ls>MS. 10. 8. 1-4</ls> and <ls>ŚB. on MS.</ls> thereon.
